verdict.rationale: Visa states its MCP server and agent toolkit let developers and non-technical users work with AI agents in plain language with no coding required, and the MCP server is published on npm. However, the documented toolkit tools mainly cover Pay by Link and Invoicing rather than the core Intelligent Commerce enrollment, mandate and credential flows. The natural-language operation also depends on an external AI agent acting as the MCP client. Missing for 10: documented natural-language coverage of the core Intelligent Commerce flows (card enrollment, purchase intents, credential retrieval), hands-on or independent corroboration that plain-language operation works, and detail beyond the marketing claim.
